caption: The drawing depicts a black sculpture of a horse's head mounted on a cylindrical base. The horse's head is rendered in detail, showing features such as the mane, eyes, ears, nostrils, and mouth. The base beneath the horse's head has embossed text that reads: "BARTLETT, SAGINAW, MICH." The cylinder extends downward and appears to be part of a post or some type of fixture. The illustration is centered on a plain, beige background with some minor discoloration or marking around the edges. The name "Albert Grain" is written in small cursive text near the bottom left of the image.
title: Hitching Post
